create_RNDModel: create an RNDModel neural network module for random network distillation intrinsic reward
run_RNDModel_get_reward: run the RNDModel get_reward method to compute intrinsic reward from state predictions
run_RNDModel_update: run the RNDModel update method to train the body model against the target network
create_QExploreLearner: create a QExploreLearner with VDN or QMixer and count or RND intrinsic exploration
run_QExploreLearner_train: run the QExploreLearner train method to perform one step of Q-learning with intrinsic rewards
